defect: FIFO full status uses an asynchronous reset different from the pointer registers it summarizes
rationale: The write and synchronized read pointers reset under rst_wr_ni, while full_o resets under independent rst_status_ni; an isolated status reset can disagree with the pointer state and admit or reject writes incorrectly.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the asynchronous FIFO to both pointers, a synchronized read pointer, and full status.

mutation.description: Put full_o in an independent asynchronous reset domain from the pointer registers that determine its value.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: full_o uses an independent async reset while consuming pointers reset by rst_wr_ni/rst_rd_ni, so a lone reset desynchronises full from pointers.
